LESSON: SIGN READING 5.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Sign Reading 5.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 5.2.1 Fluency, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to sign read fluently?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 5.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is enhanced as they read texts on ‘Occupations’ and share what they have learnt with

peers.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as the learner sign reads grade appropriate texts related to occupation with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Learner Support Programmes: peer education as the learner shares what they have read with peers to sensitise them on occupations.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to apply reading fluency skills in learning similar concept in Environmental activities.
